item.title: Cavan Gardai issue safety advice for those living alone
item.description: Gardai are appealing for information following an attempted burglary in Bailieboro. Gardai were alerted to the incident on the 17th of December at 7:30pm. item.title: Man aged in his 20s arrested over Cavan drug seizure
item.description: A man aged in his 20s has been charged over the seizure of €6,000 worth of suspected cannabis. Gardaí stopped a vehicle in Lisduff, Co. Cavan at approximately 4:15pm on Sunday afternoon. The driver a male in his 20s failed a roadside test and was arrested on suspicion of driving while under the influence of an intoxicant. item.title: 2026 to be transformative year for housing in Monaghan MD
item.description: 2026 will be a transformative year in Monaghan Municipal District for the delivery and construction of much needed social housing. That's according to Fine Gael Councillor, Alan Johnston who says over the next three years 440 new homes will be completed by Monaghan County Council. €121.5m is being provided by the Government under its Housing for All plan for the planned homes. item.title: 'Transparency needed' over unrequested funds to World Bank - Bennett
item.description: Cavan -Monaghan TD Cathy Bennett has called for "full transparency" on the decision to give the World Bank €10 million more than they had requested from Ireland. It was revealed this week that Paschal Donohoe gave 10 million euro extra to the World Bank in April last year, before he resigned as Finance Minister in November to take up a role at the World Bank. item.title: Local praise as An Post continues social welfare cash payments
item.description: Fianna Fáil TD for Cavan/Monaghan, Brendan Smith, has welcomed the announcement by Minister Dara Calleary that An Post has been awarded the Department of Social Protection’s new Cash Payment Services contract. The contract provides for over-the-counter cash payments to social welfare recipients, something Deputy Brendan Smith says is critical for people across Cavan and Monaghan. item.title: Cavan Cllr. slams stamp price increase
item.description: The cost of a stamp is set to increase by 20c from €1.65 to €1.85 on Tuesday, 3rd February, An Post has confirmed. In an announcement this week, An Post said it is taking action to safeguard national delivery services and equal access to letter services nationwide. A new €3.50 stamp for letters to anywhere in Europe, including Britain is being introduced, an increase of 85c. item.title: Emergency services at the scene of crash near Clones
item.description: Emergency services are currently at the scene of a road traffic collision in Co Fermanagh. The incident involving one vehicle occured on the Newtownbutler to Clones Road this evening. The collision is not believed to be serious however the road remains closed at this time. Advertisement Fire crews from Lisnaskea and Clones are currently in attendance at the scene along with members of the PSNI and the Northern Ireland Ambulance Service.
